name: intake-demo
description: Event intake end to end, with no model calls: an inbound event is scrubbed before it is stored, a repeat of the same key is suppressed, one run per key holds at a time, a human approves before anything leaves the run, and the approved event is filed as a ticket through an HTTP step. Pair it with demo/sink.mjs, which plays the ticket tracker and the chat webhook.

phases.name: approve-ticket
phases.description: A human approves before the run files anything outside itself.

code.source:
const e = JSON.parse(state.event);
return 'File a ' + e.severity + ' ticket for ' + e.key + ': ' + e.title;
